nameForms.name: Byzantine Empire
nameForms.note: This imperial sequence follows the throne from Basil I to Manuel I.
nameForms.noteCn: 本皇帝序列自巴西尔一世延续至曼努埃尔一世。

holders.note: Basil I founded the Macedonian dynasty.
holders.noteCn: 巴西尔一世开创马其顿王朝。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Basil I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父巴西尔一世。

holders.note: Leo VI's brother ruled briefly.
holders.noteCn: 利奥六世之弟短暂在位。

holders.note: The young Constantine VII ruled under regents.
holders.noteCn: 年幼的君士坦丁七世先由摄政统治。

holders.note: Constantine VII remained emperor while Romanos I exercised power.
holders.noteCn: 罗曼努斯一世掌权期间，君士坦丁七世仍为皇帝。

holders.note: Romanos I exercised power alongside Constantine VII.
holders.noteCn: 罗曼努斯一世与君士坦丁七世并立，实际掌握政权。

holders.note: Constantine VII resumed sole rule.
holders.noteCn: 君士坦丁七世恢复独掌政权。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Constantine VII.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父君士坦丁七世。

holders.note: Nikephoros II became emperor through marriage to Theophano.
holders.noteCn: 尼基弗鲁斯二世与狄奥法诺成婚后即位。

holders.note: John I succeeded after Nikephoros II's assassination.
holders.noteCn: 尼基弗鲁斯二世遇刺后，约翰一世继位。

holders.note: Basil II restored imperial authority in the Balkans.
holders.noteCn: 巴西尔二世重振帝国在巴尔干的权威。

holders.note: Constantine VIII was Basil II's co-emperor; Basil II directed the government.
holders.noteCn: 君士坦丁八世与巴西尔二世共治；实际政务由巴西尔二世主导。

holders.note: Succeeded his brother Basil II.
holders.noteCn: 继承其兄巴西尔二世。

holders.note: Zoe provided dynastic legitimacy to Romanos III through marriage.
holders.noteCn: 佐伊通过婚姻为罗曼努斯三世提供王朝合法性。

holders.note: Romanos III ruled through marriage to Zoe.
holders.noteCn: 罗曼努斯三世通过与佐伊成婚而统治。

holders.note: Zoe provided dynastic legitimacy to Michael IV through marriage.
holders.noteCn: 佐伊通过婚姻为米海尔四世提供王朝合法性。

holders.note: Michael IV ruled as Zoe's husband.
holders.noteCn: 米海尔四世以佐伊之夫的身份统治。

holders.note: Michael V was overthrown by the Constantinopolitan uprising.
holders.noteCn: 米海尔五世在君士坦丁堡民变中被推翻。

holders.note: Zoe returned to sovereign rule in 1042.
holders.noteCn: 佐伊于1042年恢复以自身权利统治。

holders.note: Theodora shared rule with Zoe in 1042.
holders.noteCn: 狄奥多拉于1042年与佐伊共治。

holders.note: Zoe shared the throne with Constantine IX after their marriage.
holders.noteCn: 佐伊与君士坦丁九世成婚后共掌皇位。

holders.note: Constantine IX ruled through marriage to Zoe.
holders.noteCn: 君士坦丁九世通过与佐伊成婚而统治。

holders.note: Constantine IX continued as emperor after Zoe's death.
holders.noteCn: 佐伊去世后，君士坦丁九世继续统治。

holders.note: Theodora ruled in her own right.
holders.noteCn: 狄奥多拉以自身权利统治。

holders.note: Chosen after Theodora's death.
holders.noteCn: 狄奥多拉去世后获拥立。

holders.note: Isaac I took the throne after a military revolt.
holders.noteCn: 伊萨克一世在军事叛乱后登基。

holders.note: Constantine X succeeded Isaac I.
holders.noteCn: 君士坦丁十世继承伊萨克一世。

holders.note: Eudokia governed as regent for her sons.
holders.noteCn: 欧多基娅为其诸子摄政。

holders.note: Eudokia shared imperial legitimacy with Romanos IV through marriage.
holders.noteCn: 欧多基娅通过婚姻与罗曼努斯四世共享帝国合法性。

holders.note: Romanos IV ruled through marriage to Eudokia.
holders.noteCn: 罗曼努斯四世通过与欧多基娅成婚而统治。

holders.note: Eudokia briefly resumed the regency after Romanos IV's defeat.
holders.noteCn: 罗曼努斯四世战败后，欧多基娅短暂恢复摄政。

holders.note: Michael VII succeeded amid the aftermath of Manzikert.
holders.noteCn: 曼齐刻尔特战役后局势中，米海尔七世继位。

holders.note: Nikephoros III was overthrown by Alexios I.
holders.noteCn: 尼基弗鲁斯三世被阿莱克修斯一世推翻。

holders.note: Alexios I began the Komnenian restoration.
holders.noteCn: 阿莱克修斯一世开启科穆宁中兴。

holders.note: Succeeded his father Alexios I.
holders.noteCn: 继承其父阿莱克修斯一世。

holders.note: Succeeded John II.
holders.noteCn: 继承约翰二世。
